explanation: Magie designed it to show how landlords grow rich while tenants fall into debt. Charles Darrow sold his version to Parker Brothers in 1935 and was long credited as the inventor.

claims.text: Lizzie Magie received a US patent for The Landlord's Game in 1904, and Monopoly developed from that game.
Charles Darrow, Milton Bradley and George Parker did not patent The Landlord's Game.
Magie designed The Landlord's Game to show how rents enrich landlords and impoverish tenants.
Charles Darrow sold Monopoly to Parker Brothers in 1935.
Charles Darrow was long credited as the inventor of Monopoly.
